steps.content: Two months have passed since the attack at the speech.

A lot has happened within these two months: The attacker has been detained, the Syndican block's residents have received compensation, several developers have gone bankrupt... The incident has a fairly satisfying ending.
Except for...

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: The search warrant concerning Reagan still hasn't come through yet?
Reagan's background is far more complicated than we imagined. It's already a miracle to have been able to bypass him and compensate the Syndican residents.
You understand Cinnabar's concern. After all, as long as Reagan is still in power, Serpent Eye can suffer retaliation anytime.
I'll give another call to Serpent Eye.
You've already phoned Serpent Eye several times. As you've expected, no one picks up this time either.
You've lost touch with Serpent Eye.
Watching your perplexed face, Cinnabar begins to comfort you instead.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Take it easy, I'm sure they're fine.
Three days later
Alyosha?!
Nightingale looks at you quizzically, unsure why you seem so agitated by the call from this Alyosha guy.
You take the phone from Nightingale.
Captain Alyosha? I haven't been able to reach you by phone. How's everything going for you?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Serpent Eye's number has changed.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Get Cinnabar on the phone.
That's just typical of Alyosha to not give you any respect, but now is not the time to be petty.
When Cinnabar learns that Serpent Eye is on the phone, she drops everything and rushes to your office.
Cinnabar takes the phone from your hand, pauses, and turns on the speaker.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: How have you been, Alyosha? Did Reagan give you any trouble?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Serpent Eye isn't working with City Council now.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Is it because of what happened last time? I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Don't make stupid guesses.

steps.speaker: Noise
steps.content: You still haven't finished your drink, Captain. Who are you talking to on the phone? But it can't be Cinnabar?
Raucous noise comes from the other end of the phone.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: ...If you've got any questions, you know where to find me. I happen to be... free now.
Alyosha hangs up without hesitation.
Cinnabar holds the phone in the air for a long while before putting it down.
I'll go with you.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Um...
Cinnabar seems hesitant.
You don't want me to go?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: That's not what I mean.
You only mean to tease her with the question, but she's taking it seriously.
I hope it's not because you're annoyed at me following you around?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: How can I be annoyed at you!
To your surprise, Cinnabar is flustered at your obvious teasing.
To prove that she treats you as a confidant, Cinnabar insists that you go with her to meet her family.
You agree with pleasure, and go with her to the meeting spot hinted by Alyosha, an old depot on the border separating Eastside and Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Serpent Eye was founded here. Thirty years ago, Dad... my father, Alyosha, and the others rented this place to use as their quarters and training arena.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: This is the origin of Serpent Eye.
Boisterous chatter can be heard from inside the building.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Let's go inside.
As the door is pushed open, you are greeted by a sweet wine fragrance and animated chatter.
The depot is furnished like a bar. Under the warm light, the place looks cozy and welcoming everywhere.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Hey, Cinnabar, I see you've even brought someone with you.
The seniors are drinking around the long table. As they spot Cinnabar and you, they drag the both of you close hospitably and sit you down at the table.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: This is my current employer, the Chief of MBCC. You've met during the last mission.
Two empty vodka bottles stand in front of him, and the third one is already half-finished. He can surely hold his liquor.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Haven't you had too much to drink? The headache's gonna kill you tomorrow morning.
Catching the sarcastic remark of his comrade, Alyosha slams the glass loudly on the table and spits out two words—

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: F**k off.
You make your way to Alyosha and say hi. But he pretends he doesn't see you and says nothing back, continuing to down his alcohol. The third bottle is almost empty too now.
You return indignantly.
Recalling how Alyosha has behaved in the past, you still feel intimidated to talk to him directly, so you turn to the friendly Serpent Eye members next to you.
What's happened to your captain?

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Oh, don't mind him. That's our boss for you. He was over the moon when he knew you guys were coming, but once you came in, he went back to being an ass.

The crowd is giddy with chatter and laughter, shooting ceaseless questions at Cinnabar about her life in the past few years. It's obvious that their friendliness toward you is courtesy of Cinnabar, because they really adore her.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Tell us more about your life these two years, Cinnabar.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Alyosha has sent someone to get updates, but he's kept his mouth shut this whole time.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Since the City Council began hunting me down, I've lived in Syndicate.
Cinnabar has helped civilians dodge gang attacks a few times in Syndicate. She's saved plenty of people.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Cinnabar is a star wherever she goes. She's always been like this since she was little.
Oh? Since she was little?

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: You don't say.
The veteran is obviously preening himself.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: My childhood... was nothing special. My father passed away early, I was raised by the seniors of Serpent Eye.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Cinnabar's pa was our comrade, we all risked our lives for the higher-ups in those days. After retiring in N.F. 84, we were re-hired as a mercenary unit. The first two years, we picked up jobs on the Broken Frontline that others didn't dare touch...

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: That geezer was always babbling about the big money we were going to make together, but then he went down first in DisSea...
Reminiscing the past, the veterans of Serpent Eye are getting teary-eyed.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: My father's gone, but I'm here to take his place at Serpent Eye.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Oh yeah, look at you. You graduated top of your class from the police academy, but you didn't even try to get one of those fancy civil servant jobs... You could have at least joined the real army of FAC. What are you doing here rolling with geezers like us anyway?

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Oh boy, if it hadn't been for Cinnabar, none of us would have survived DisSea, let alone won the contract to protect the City Council.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: But even protecting the City Council is risking life and limb, one misstep can mean death. If anything happened to Cinnabar, how could we face her pa on the other side?
Seeing the old men starting to worry for themselves again, Cinnabar tries to reassure them at once.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Everything I have has been given to me by Serpent Eye, Serpent Eye is my home... It's only natural that I come back...

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Enough!
Having been silent the entire time, Alyosha stands up abruptly and makes for the exit.
People in the bar are all searching each other's faces for some clue of what just happened. Cinnabar seems particularly mortified, uncertain what she's said has upset Alyosha.
Didn't you say you were going to talk to Cinnabar? She's already said so much, have you got nothing to tell her?
Alyosha stops short and turns to stare straight at Cinnabar, then croaks with a wave of drunken anger.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Serpent Eye is your home?! Then what is that place you're staying in?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: You'd rather stay in that shitty place like a prison and be ordered around like an inmate than come home?!
Alyosha is growling at Cinnabar, but you know full well whom his accusations are really meant for.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: I see you've long forgotten...

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I have never forgotten anything.
Cinnabar stands up and begins to counter Alyosha earnestly while holding his gaze.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: If Serpent Eye hadn't given me the education I had and taught me the important values in life, I wouldn't have grown up to be the person I am today.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: When I first joined Serpent Eye, if it hadn't been for the protection from José, Don... and you, I would have died.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: It's exactly because Serpent Eye has always protected me, I want to be like you, to protect everyone in sight...
At that moment, Cinnabar's voice sinks.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Those unrealistic ideals of mine and the stubborn urge to protect others probably all come from my admiration for you guys.
Alyosha looks stunned and at a loss for words. After a moment, he finally continues a little indignantly.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: Then who is it that you want to protect now? Don't tell me it's this kid who keeps you in chains?

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: The person who feels the need to monitor you even when you're having a private gathering! Who won't set you free, wanting to trap you in that shitty place for the rest of your life!

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: You've misunderstood. I'm a Sinner. As you know, this identity is the main reason why the City Council wanted to hunt me down in the first place. Leaving MBCC at this juncture will only cause unnecessary trouble.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: The Chief is also not the person you've described, but a reliable employer and my confidant whom I trust my life with. The Chief only came with me because I insisted.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: The Chief has never forced me to stay in MBCC, it's my own choice.
Alyosha opens his mouth, but struggles to speak even a single word. Perhaps he's already accepted the truth, and is only grappling mentally with his pride.
With no good counter-responses, an utterly baffled Alyosha returns to his corner and flops back into the seat, raises the bottle, and then downs all the remaining content in it.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Yes.
Alyosha's eyes widen.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: The Chief is a very important person to me.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: It's my own choice to stay in MBCC.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: But this kid... and you...
Perhaps the alcohol is finally kicking in, as Alyosha is mumbling incoherently, struggling to form any meaningful sentences. Cinnabar keeps her head low and simply smiles vaguely.
With no good responses, an utterly baffled Alyosha returns to his corner and flops back into the seat, raises the bottle, and then downs all the remaining content in it.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: You can't expect your kid to always stay by your side when she's grown up. You should learn to let go, old man.
As the Serpent Eye members begin cracking jokes, the atmosphere is pleasant and amicable again.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: To celebrate Cinnabar's homecoming, today's drinks are all on Alyosha!
Alyosha, who's already collapsed on the bar from all the drinks he's had, is currently snoring and has no means to object.
Boisterously, people are beginning to give toasts. You can feel several pairs of scheming eyes gathering on you.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Since you're our dear Cinnabar's friend, allow us to treat you to a few more drinks!

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Since you're our dear Cinnabar's good friend, allow us to treat you to a few more drinks!
The other Serpent Eye members agree unanimously.
There seems to be no way out. it's probably disrespectful to refuse the drinks from these geezers, but if you accept them... you very likely won't find your way home today.
The second you lift your hand, Cinnabar takes the glass from you smoothly, and drains it.
Just as you're about to refuse politely, Cinnabar beats you to it, lifts your glass, and drains it.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Does anyone else want to toast the Chief?
A somewhat strange smile emerges on Cinnabar's face. This is the first time you've seen her like this.
Strangely, witnessing Cinnabar's behavior, the geezers from Serpent Eye begin to search each other's faces. An odd trepidation can be seen in all of their eyes.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Are you kidding me? You're being overprotective.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I have nothing against responsible drinking. But are you sure you plan to drink responsibly? I know you guys too well.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member A
steps.content: Nonsense... Haha...

steps.speaker: Serpent Member B
steps.content: Challenge accepted. Who knows, maybe she's gotten rusty these two years. In any case, she can't outdrink all of us on her own, can she?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Try me.

Just like that, the high-spirited crowd kicks off the drinking contest. Soon after, the loudest ones are already collapsing. Cinnabar returns to your side, she looks very calm, without even the slightest hint of flush on her face.
How... how can you hold your liquor so well?

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Finishing the drinks a client gets offered is part of the job of a bodyguard too.
Cinnabar glances at the clock on the bar.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: I remember you still have some unfinished work.
You don't want to stay here a bit longer?
Cinnabar turns back to look at the geezers. Her gaze is warm and affectionate.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: There will be a next time...
Clank!
A loud thump interrupts your conversation. Apparently, Alyosha has woken up and fallen onto the floor. Cinnabar wants to help him up, but her hand gets slapped off.

steps.speaker: Alyosha
steps.content: I'm not that old.

Alyosha makes his wobbly way to your side. Thinking he might want to force you to drink, Cinnabar is ready to stop him. To your surprise, he simply looks at you, and looks at Cinnabar. He shakes his head and lets out a long sigh.
After that, he pats you heavily on the shoulder, twice.
You understand the meaning behind this act—he's accepted you.

steps.speaker: Serpent Member
steps.content: Woohoo!
Seeing that, the Serpent Eye members immediately begin to cheer and whistle. Alyosha's meaning is clear—he's accepted you.
